title: Largest of three
description:
Write `int largestOfThree(int a, int b, int c)` using `if` statements.

A tidy way: assume the first is the largest, then let each of the others replace it if it is bigger.
hints: Start with `int largest{ a };`. Then ask two separate questions: is `b` bigger than `largest`? Is `c` bigger than `largest`? Each time the answer is yes, replace `largest`.
Use two separate `if` statements, not `else if`: both comparisons must always run.
